criteria.text: budgets.bundleBytes in the profile maps file paths to a byte cap; the default profile declares it as an empty map, so projects that do not set it are unaffected.
Preflight fails when a file named in budgets.bundleBytes is larger than its cap, and the failure details name the file, its size and its cap.
Preflight passes when every file named in budgets.bundleBytes is at or under its cap, and skips when the map is empty or absent.
A file named in budgets.bundleBytes that does not exist is skipped, not failed, and the details list it.

items.title: Test for the bundle size check

criteria.text: A test in tests/ covers the over-cap, at-cap, empty-map and missing-file cases of the check.
